meta_description:
5,487 likes, 88 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 17, 2026: "We think we just found one of the most underrated day trips from London 🚂

Comment ‘travel’ for more of @expedia top destination guides and itineraries!

Just 90 minutes away by train, this little city has Roman history, beautiful countryside and incredible English sparkling wine. Searches for stays in Chichester have risen by 30%, according to @expedia, making it one of the world’s fastest-growing travel destinations for 2027. If you’re looking for things to do there, save our list below:

📍Chichester Cathedral — Take a look at the incredible medieval architecture, colourful modern art and the unusual freestanding bell tower outside.

📍The Novium Museum — Discover Chichester’s Roman history and see the remains of an ancient Roman bathhouse beneath the museum.

📍Tinwood Estate — Visit a local Sussex vineyard to try English sparkling wine, surrounded by the beautiful countryside.

📍South Downs National Park — Head out of the city for rolling green hills, countryside walks and beautiful autumn colours, Harting Down is one of our favourites, and don’t forget to visit the famous Halnaker Tree Tunnel, best visited in autumn.

📍Chichester Harbour — If you prefer a waterside walk, explore the harbour for coastal views and a relaxed pace.

Whether you spend the day exploring the city or turn it into a countryside weekend break, Chichester is definitely worth adding to your list. 

@expedia
📍Chichester, England".
